source: Khemakhem et al. (2021) CAREFL Fig. 5 data, committed in tensorchiefs/tram-dag data/CAREFL_CF and consumed by comparison/carefl_fig5.r (USE_EXTERNAL_DATA = TRUE)

files.X.csv: the 2500 training rows, CAREFL's own draw; x3/x4 sd-standardized
files.xCF_onX1_true.csv: analytic x4 counterfactual under do(x1 = alpha)
files.xCF_onX2_true.csv: analytic x3 counterfactual under do(x2 = alpha)
files.xCF_onX1_pred.csv: CAREFL's own x4 predictions (the Fig. 6 baseline)

alphas: seq(-3, 2.9, 0.1) - 60 points, the grid of all four curve files
note: External frozen input with no generator in this repository (like misc/data/magic-mrclean): x3 and x4 are divided by the sds above, carefl_fig5.r's hardcoded SDX3/SDX4. paper.check_data cannot regenerate this folder and does not list it.
